verdict.rationale: Autumn is an API-driven billing platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair ask, but the pack never shows one. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The human-readable API reference pages and llms.txt are adjacent documentation, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
